name: z80-skills
description: Standalone adaptive workflow plus evidence-first audit, organization, size, and optimization skills for Z80/C projects.

interface.shortDescription: Adaptive workflow and evidence-first Z80 engineering.
interface.longDescription: Bundles an independent workflow skill with audit-z80, organize-z80, shrink-z80, and optimize-z80. Workflow owns adaptive Sol/Luna execution; each Z80 skill retains its domain evidence, safety, and mutation contracts.
defaultPrompt: Use workflow to select the smallest sufficient execution level for this engineering task.
Use audit-z80 to review this Z80/C change.
Use organize-z80 to map this Z80/C project's ownership and identify the smallest safe organizational next step.
Use shrink-z80 to find size wins in this build.
Use optimize-z80 to find the best speed/RAM optimization path.
Audit ABI, stack, ISR, memory, and map risks.
